text:
Parameter kcat. Construct SYNTH-A.
Central estimate 10 s^-1.
Reported SD 12 min^-1.
There are four independent preparations; the same four estimates are summarized by this SD.
Each preparation supplies exactly one fitted kcat estimate, and this SD summarizes exactly those preparation estimates.
SD uses the sample n-1 denominator. The estimates are IID with a common mean and finite variance.
The central estimate, when available, is their equal-weight arithmetic mean.
